scenario.summary: The Storm-2561 campaign uses SEO poisoning on search engines like Bing to direct users to lookalike VPN download sites. These sites harvest credentials through a multi-stage JavaScript prompt before delivering a legitimate, signed WatchGuard installer to avoid suspicion. Stolen credentials are then utilized for unauthorized access to external remote services.

hunt.name: WatchGuard VPN Lookalike Phishing and Payload Delivery
hunt.description: This hunt identifies hosts that interacted with lookalike WatchGuard VPN domains identified in recent threat research. The attack chain involves a redirection from search engines like Bing, interaction with a phishing lure site, and a forced credential entry prompt. The hunt first identifies candidate hosts via DNS activity, then examines HTTP and network traffic to identify lure interaction and credential POSTing. Finally, it correlates this activity with the subsequent download and execution of the legitimate WatchGuard SSL VPN installer, which is used to mask the theft and satisfy the user's original intent.

nodes.label: Scope hosts by DNS lookups to lure domains

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookup_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE LOWER(query_hostname) = LOWER(d.query_hostname) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')) AS host_prevalence, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity d WHERE instr(',' || '{{lure_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Identify any hosts that attempted to resolve the lookalike or collector domains to narrow the investigation and provide prevalence context.
config.expected_signal: Hosts resolving the phishing domains. Host prevalence shows if a domain is unique to one user or common across the fleet.

primitive_config.expected: Hosts resolving the phishing domains. Host prevalence shows if a domain is unique to one user or common across the fleet.

nodes.label: Search for search-redirects and lure URI hits

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname, url_path, referrer, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{lure_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND (LOWER(referrer) LIKE '%bing.com%' OR LOWER(referrer) LIKE '%google.com%') AND (instr(',' || '{{lure_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_path) || ',') > 0 OR url_path = '/') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find HTTP evidence of the SEO redirection from search engines and interaction with the harvesting infrastructure.
config.expected_signal: HTTP requests showing the user arriving at a lure domain from a search engine and interacting with index.php or popup.js.
